provider.name: Euro+Med PlantBase
provider.organization_type: Euro-Mediterranean vascular plant checklist, taxonomy, nomenclature, distribution, bibliography, and expert-edited data platform
provider.description: Euro+Med PlantBase is an expert-edited information resource for vascular plant diversity in Europe and the Mediterranean region. It provides accepted names, synonyms, taxonomic classifications, nomenclatural details, bibliographic references, geographic distributions, status annotations, and source provenance.
institutional_context: Botanic Garden and Botanical Museum Berlin

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Euro+Med PlantBase documentation, taxonomy, nomenclature, distributions, area-code vocabularies, references, editorial workflows, platform APIs, downloads, licenses, citations, and institutional context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Euro+Med PlantBase, its editors, BGBM, and cited taxonomic sources remain authoritative for accepted names, synonymy, distributions, references, data versions, legal terms, and contact information.

notes: Verify the current public CDM server base URL, endpoint versions, serialization formats, authentication, and rate limits.
Do not infer undocumented write endpoints or administrative services from the public data portal.
Distinguish Euro+Med-specific APIs from generic EDIT Platform CDM service documentation.
Capture UUIDs, taxon and name identifiers, classification IDs, query parameters, paging, response schemas, and deprecations.
Capture exact official legal wording before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate taxonomic facts, editorial text, distributions, bibliographic compilations, media, downloads, APIs, and software.
Preserve source reference, editor, contributor, data version, record identifier, media rights holder, and license URI.
Do not assume platform or software licensing applies to Euro+Med taxonomic records or third-party media.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Some current and legacy portal paths, CDM service URLs, documentation pages, and download locations may redirect, be renamed, or be unavailable; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every taxon, name, reference, image, or search result when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store passwords, cookies, API tokens, administrative credentials, OAuth tokens, or session credentials in this JSON file.
Taxonomic facts, editorial content, distributions, references, media, downloads, APIs, and source code may carry different rights.
Always preserve taxon UUID, name UUID, accepted-name relationship, synonym type, distribution area, status symbol, source reference, editor, version, license, and provenance.
